text:
Lena (Docs): Quick sync: product wants changelog published with localized blurbs (EN/FR/DE/JP) and a short migration note about the embeddings endpoint deprecation. Who can do translations and verify snippet parity?
Ava (Docs): I can draft the EN copy now. For localization we'll need sign-off from Ravi and QA on translated snippets. Keep the announcement concise.
Priya (PM): PM asks for one customer-facing sentence about the embeddings deprecation: migration path + timeline (60 days). Also note a rollback path.
Ravi (I18n): I can coordinate FR/DE/JP. Need source strings in a key/value format. Prefer to get them in a single PR so we can run the i18n checks.
Marco (SDK): Heads-up: the embed endpoint change also affects example curl and Node snippets. Node currently uses /v1/embeddings?model=legacy. New path is /api/embeddings and param changed to model_id.
Ava (Docs): Can you paste the exact snippet diff?
Marco (SDK): Old:```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?model=legacy -d '\n{"input":"text"}'
``` New:```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/api/embeddings -d '\n{"model_id":"embed-2026-small","input":"text"}'
```
Lena (Docs): Perfect. I'll update the curl, Node, and Python snippets.
docs-ci: lint failed on branch release/changelog-localization (linkcheck, i18n-lint) :x:
Ava (Docs): Error details?
docs-ci: linkcheck reported failing redirect to /models/embeddings-old, i18n-lint flagged missing French string key changelog.deprecation.embeddings.blurb.fr
Ravi (I18n): I'll add the missing French key. Also remind that DE phrasing should avoid literal "deprecated" in customer-facing copy; use "scheduled removal" wording.
Priya (PM): Use "scheduled removal in 60 days" phrasing. Make the migration steps explicit: 1) change endpoint, 2) update model param name, 3) run small-sample test.
Ava (Docs): Draft migration bullets for the changelog: - What changed (endpoint + param) - Why (router consolidation) - Action (update client snippets) - Rollback (use older model-id alias 'embed-legacy' via support request)
Marco (SDK): Also update SDK import path in Go snippets: old github.com/redwood/sdk -> github.com/redwood/inference-go/sdk (same as earlier note). And bump example client constructor to use WithAPIHost("api.redwood.ai").
Lena (Docs): I'll add a short note under "Known issues": some customers may see 400s if they pass model instead of model_id; suggest quick fix snippet showing the corrected payload.
Ava (Docs): Add compatibility note for older clients: include a migration shim example for Node using headers to set X-Enable-Legacy-Model: true.
Marco (SDK): Example shim:```js
fetch(url, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type':'application/json', 'X-Enable-Legacy-Model': 'true' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model_id: 'embed-2026-small', input: 'hi' })
})
```
Lena (Docs): Good. Ravi, once FR/DE/JP strings are in, can you run a quick spot-check on the translated code comments? They sometimes get dropped in the i18n pipeline.
Ravi (I18n): Will do. I'll also add a short gov-compliance note for JP locale about data residency wording.
docs-ci: lint passing on branch release/changelog-localization (linkcheck fixed, i18n-lint pending) :white_check_mark:
Ava (Docs): Final items before merge: 1) add localized blurbs (Ravi) 2) update all code snippets (Lena/Marco) 3) add known-issue about 400s and migration shim (Lena) 4) PM sign-off on customer sentence (Priya) 5) docs-ci green.
Priya (PM): Approved the customer-facing sentence. Use: "Embeddings API endpoint is being consolidated; migrate to /api/embeddings using model_id by 2026-05-10 to avoid interruption."
Lena (Docs): Merged the snippet fixes into release/changelog-localization. Publishing to staging.
docs-ci: build passed and deployed to staging branch release/changelog-localization :white_check_mark:
Ava (Docs): I'll run a quick manual smoke test on staging for EN/FR. If no issues, we'll publish at 15:00 UTC and ping Marketing for the external note.
Marco (SDK): Ran snippet-tests against staging; Node/Python pass, Go needs the import path change merged (PR 4140).
Ravi (I18n): French strings pushed and spot-checked. DE and JP follow in the next 30m.
Lena (Docs): Sweet. Thanks team — small, targeted release. If anyone spots a malformed redirect or broken snippet, drop logs here and we'll roll back the changelog commit (ops/runbooks/changelog-rollback). :shipit:
